---
name: Scheduled maintenance
about: Announce planned maintenance on the status page
title: "Scheduled maintenance <date> <start>–<end> CET"
labels: maintenance
---

<!--
Times are ISO 8601 in UTC (Swedish winter time is UTC+1, summer time UTC+2).
expectedDown / expectedDegraded take component slugs, comma-separated:
website-attesteo-com, bank-id-external
Upptime closes this issue automatically at `end`.

start: 2026-01-01T21:00:00+00:00
end: 2026-01-01T22:00:00+00:00
expectedDown: website-attesteo-com
-->

**What:** Brief description of the work.

**Expected impact:** For example "Signing and the admin app may be unavailable for up to 10 minutes during the window."

**Why:** One sentence on the reason, if useful to customers.
